title: cw task add-checks --input
description: Go test checks added to a started substantial task after a merge of its base branch. cw also checks rules this schema does not state; cw task add-checks --help lists them.

merge_commit.description: The merge commit that took in the base branch.

base_ref.description: The base branch ref merged, such as origin/main.

reason.description: Why the checks are added, 1 to 16384 bytes.

argv.description: The command, run without a shell.

env_passthrough.description: Names of variables cw would otherwise drop that the check receives; never values.
